description: RFI explicitly names products and release.
input:
## Background

The agency is modernizing its IT service management platform on ServiceNow ITSM. The proposed solution must run on the Washington release and incorporate Now Assist for ITSM for case summarization.

expected.summary: RFI is scoped to ITSM on the Washington release with Now Assist for ITSM.

description: One ServiceNow module mentioned; no release named.
input: We are evaluating ServiceNow Customer Service Management to replace our incumbent case-handling system. The RFI focuses on contact-center workflows and omnichannel intake.

expected.summary: RFI is scoped to CSM with a focus on contact-center workflows.

description: Multiple distinct ServiceNow modules in scope.
input: This RFI covers three ServiceNow product areas: ITSM for incident and change, ITOM for discovery and event management, and HRSD for employee service center workflows.

expected.summary: RFI is scoped to ITSM, ITOM, and HRSD.

description: RFI is about replacing a Workday system and does not reference ServiceNow at all. Should abstain.
input: The State of Example is seeking proposals to replace its existing Workday HCM with a modern employee experience platform. The replacement system must support recruiting, onboarding, time/attendance, payroll, and learning management.

description: Mentions ServiceNow only as a comparable product, not as the target platform. Conservative: don't list.
input: The agency is evaluating a modern ticketing solution comparable to ServiceNow or Jira Service Management. The selected platform need not be one of these specific products; the RFI is platform-agnostic.

expected.summary: RFI does not specify ServiceNow scope — ServiceNow is mentioned only as a comparable product.

description: Release explicitly named; ITSM context strongly implied.
input: Submissions should reference behavior on the Vancouver release. The relevant subject area is incident, problem, and change workflows for our IT operations group.

expected.summary: RFI is scoped to ITSM on the Vancouver release.

input: This RFI evaluates dashboard and reporting capabilities using ServiceNow Performance Analytics on the Yokon release.

expected.summary: RFI is scoped to Performance Analytics on Yokon.

description: Vague 'modernize ITSM' without naming products explicitly. Conservative: list ITSM, no version.
input: The agency intends to modernize its IT service management capability. Proposals should describe ITSM functionality including incident, problem, and change management.

expected.summary: RFI is scoped to ITSM with a focus on incident, problem, and change management.
